text: APPROVE. The extraction keeps the per-file ordering and accumulation intact, the negated `continue` condition is correctly inverted into `inheriting.Count > 0 && !inheriting.Any(j => j.Opaque) && TopLevelPermissionsIndex(text) is { } top`, and the iterator is consumed immediately by `AddRange`. My estimate is that the new helper scores about 10 and the outer method about 4, both under 15, and I see nothing likely to break the warnings-as-errors build.
